title: Formal Certification of Non-Additivity of Polytope Extension Complexity Under Cartesian Products
abstract: We present a machine-checked formal verification and zero-float rational certificate suite (XC-NONADD-CERT-1.0) auditing Minhao Liu's disproof of Conjecture 1.2 of Grande, Padrol, and Sanyal (arXiv:2611.33631v1), establishing that linear extension complexity is strictly subadditive under Cartesian products of polytopes. Our artifact comprises an 18-theorem constructive Lean 4.35.0 kernel (0 sorry, 0 custom axioms, 0 Classical.choice, 0 warnings), an AST-audited zero-float Python verifier over Z and Q, 16 canonical JSON certificates (C01-C16), and 34 unit and forgery-rejection tests covering the 24x39 six-cycle matrix S, exact rank-14 and rank-27 (all 1,521 columns of S x_1 S) nonnegative factorizations, Proposition 9 contraction budgets (663/2500<1 and 62412/76523<1), explicit 24-dimensional 50-facet 150-vertex rational polytope P with xc(P)=40, xc(P x P)=79, and 7-bit zero-error channel savings (128<129), plus Theorem 2 unbounded linear ceil(5n/27) and identical-square deficits.
